API:
  POST /api/login body[customer_id, password] query[] -> 200 returns[token, name]
  POST /api/logout body[] query[] -> 200 returns[message] (sign-in needed)
  GET /api/view-loans body[] query[] -> 200 returns[results] fields[account_number, outstanding_balance, emi_amount, next_emi_date, status] (sign-in needed)
  GET /api/view-emi-details body[] query[loan_account] -> 200 returns[record] fields[account_number, emi_amount, next_emi_date, principal_component, interest_component, outstanding_balance] (sign-in needed)
  GET /api/get-payment-accounts body[] query[] -> 200 returns[results] fields[account_number, account_type, balance] (sign-in needed)
  GET /api/view-payment-history body[] query[] -> 200 returns[results] fields[payment_date, amount, transaction_ref, status] (sign-in needed)
  POST /api/select-loan body[loan_account] query[] -> 200 returns[message] (sign-in needed)
  POST /api/pay-emi body[loan_account, payment_account] query[] -> 201 returns[message, transaction_ref, new_balance, new_outstanding] (sign-in needed)
  Sign in with POST /api/login; send the token it returns as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

DATABASE (tables and columns - no data):
  customer: customer_id, password, name, email, status
  loan: account_number, customer_id, outstanding_balance, emi_amount, principal_component, interest_component, next_emi_date, status, last_payment_date, last_payment_txn
  account: account_number, customer_id, account_type, balance, status
  payment: transaction_ref, loan_account, payment_account, amount, principal, interest, payment_date, payment_datetime, status

TEST CONTROLS: POST /test/reset (Back to the starting data.); POST /test/advance-minutes (Move the application's clock forward.); POST /test/simulate (Switch on a simulated failure (see the list).); GET /test/outbox (Emails, SMS and alerts the application has sent.); GET /test/clock (The application's current date and time.)
Simulated failures: payment_timeout, bank_server_error

import os
import sys
import traceback
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options as ChromeOptions
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

def incomplete(step):
    print(f"INCOMPLETE: {step}")
    sys.exit(3)

driver = None

try:
    # Setup
    chrome_options = ChromeOptions()
    chrome_options.add_argument('--headless=new')
    driver = webdriver.Remote(os.environ["SELENIUM_GRID_URL"], options=chrome_options)
    practice_url = os.environ["PRACTICE_APP_URL"]
    
    # Step 1: After login
    try:
        driver.get(f"{practice_url}/page/login")
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "customer_id").send_keys("CUST001")
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "password").send_keys("Pass@123")
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "login").click()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: step 1 - After login: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 2: Check for "Signed in as Test User"
    try:
        signed_in_text = driver.find_element(By.ID, "signed-in-user").text
        if "Test User" in signed_in_text:
            print("PASS: Signed in as Test User")
        else:
            print(f"FAIL: Signed in as Test User - expected 'Test User', got '{signed_in_text}'")
            sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: step 2 - Check for Signed in as Test User: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 3: Locate EMI Details and click
    try:
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "nav-emi-details").click()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: step 3 - Locate EMI Details and click: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 4: Locate loan account and enter his account details (SAV-1001)
    try:
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "loan_account").send_keys("SAV-1001")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: step 4 - Locate loan account and enter his account details: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 5: Locate EMI Payment and click
    try:
        driver.find_element(By.ID, "nav-emi-payment").click()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"FAIL: step 5 - Locate EMI Payment and click: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    # Step 6: Locate Outstanding balance and verify it shows 125000.00
    incomplete("Locate Outstanding balance and verify it shows 125000.00")
    
    print("PASS: all steps and checks passed")
    
finally:
    if driver:
        driver.quit()
